_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Not knowing polite lines to ask for help

segments.text: Do not understand someone? Here are four easy lines. Repeat after me.

native.caption: Не поняли собеседника и растерялись? Сохраните 4 простые фразы, например “Can you help, please?” и “Can you say that again?”. Послушайте Карлоса, а в паузе повторите сами. Больше практики в приложении Lexkite.

en.hook: Did not understand? Say it in English
en.caption: Did not understand the other person and froze? Save 4 easy lines, such as “Can you help, please?” and “Can you say that again?” Listen to Carlos, then repeat in the pause. More practice is in the Lexkite app.
